header.soulLedgerTitle: Show all active quirks and blessings
header.ledgerSub: Quirks are scars of the soul — they survive the wheel. Blessings belong to the body and end with it.

rest.label: Rest · Short
rest.knits: The wound knits deep, but not whole — true healing waits for the fire at the chapter's edge.

shrine.label: Shrine · A god is listening
shrine.empty: The altar is silent. The gods have emptied their hands to you — there are no blessings left to offer.

elite.title: An Elite Bars the Way
elite.intro: {name} holds this ground — scarred, deadly, and guarding something the dark does not give up lightly. You can take it on, or take the coin it watches over and slip past.
elite.fightBodyA: Risk the harder battle. A victory yields
elite.goldBodyA: Slip past with the coin it guards
elite.goldBodyB: . The guardian's blade still finds you on the way out — a wound that cuts deeper the more life you carry,
elite.goldBodyC: entering the next room. No XP, no loot, no relic.

camp.label: Camp · A pause on the long road · The deeper dark ahead
camp.goldTitle: Gold in pocket — what you can spend at the caravan
camp.forkIntro: ◆ The campfire — take one, the other two close ◆

rest.title: Make Camp at the Fire
rest.flavor: A full night by the coals. Wounds close, dice come home to the hand, and what was spent is yours again before dawn.
rest.taken: Full rest — HP restored, all resources readied.

attune.title: Attune by the Coals
attune.flavor: A long study of what you carry. Bind one lasting boon into yourself — it holds for the rest of this delve.
attune.panelBody: The road has marked you. Bind one boon to carry south — this is the night's whole gift, so choose with the dark in mind.

risk.title: Tempt the Dark
risk.flavor: Throw the bones into the fire and speak a name. Something out past the light is always listening — and it does not give for free.
risk.loss: The dark took its due (rolled {roll}). −{damage} HP.
risk.panelBody: One throw of the bones. No fight, no flight — only the roll and what it brings.
risk.highBody: — the dark answers: a blessing's whisper and {gold} gold (or {altGold} gold if no blessing is left to give).
risk.lowBody: — it takes its due: you lose {damage} HP (a quarter of your health), down to no less than 1.

caravan.title: ◆ The Caravan-Merchant
caravan.quote: "Coin in this pocket, comfort in the other. The road keeps going — best you're well-stocked before the dark."

shop.title: The Caravan-Merchant
shop.sub: Coin and a charter, no questions asked.

msg.legendaryBound: {name} bound to your reliquary — attune it at the hub.

findWeakSpot.label: Find the weak spot
findWeakSpot.hint: Free. Advantage on your opening attack (weapon) or first saving throw (caster).

study.label: Study the approach
study.hint: Advantage on your opening strike and first save vs the boss, plus {n} temporary HP.

walkPast.label: Walk past
walkPast.hint: Walk past. The bold take their road and ask no questions.

event.label: Event · The road pauses
event.sealedNote: The signs are here, but the art of reading them is not yet yours. Descend deeper into the dark to learn it.
event.nothing: Nothing of note here. The corridor goes on.

wares.relicFallback: A relic that death cannot take.

screen.noDelve: No active delve. Return to Phandalin.

coach.copy: An Elite — a harder fight than the road around it, and richer for it. The choice to brave it is yours.

campScene.1: A roadside fire under a dusk sky, the road bending south.
campScene.2: A lamp on a coil of rope at the end of a jetty, the gilded towers of Athkatla across dark water, a smuggler's wherry tied alongside.
campScene.3: A smokeless chemical-fire in a brass bowl lighting a smuggler's cache in an Underdark cavern, stalactites overhead.
campScene.4: A cold fire on a rocky shelf at the edge of a rift, pale golden light rising from the crack in the floor ahead.
campScene.5: A guttering fire at the rim of an immense Wheel in absolute void, a worn pilgrim offering a cup.
campScene.6: A shuttered lamp at the lip of a stair that drops into cold salt-dark, a deep-salvager paying out sounding-rope toward a library drowned far below.
campScene.7: A fire on the last wet stone where black water ends and an ashfield begins, a figure in the rags of an unknown uniform warming its hands as ash drifts down.
campScene.8: A small fire on a cracked marble dance-floor among standing shards of mirror, a hooded figure watching a reflection whose masked face does not match.
campScene.9: A low fire on the forest floor beneath a canopy burning orange overhead, embers drifting down, a fugitive elf seated with an unstrung bow across its knees.
campScene.10: A pale soul-light guttering on a narrow ledge above a vast breathing pit in a red hell, words scratched into the rock beside it.
campScene.11: A thin refugee fire on a ridge above a walled city ringed in flame and giants, smoke rising from Saradush burning below, huddled figures sharing the warmth.
campScene.12: A watch-fire where the road forks toward two dark doors — a drow gate beneath a mountain on the left, a dragon's lair in the deep waste on the right — a Harper turning a blade in the light.
campScene.13: A keeperless fire on a folded fragment of plane adrift in the void, a single dark door standing free behind it, an ally seated across the flame with eyes turned away.
campScene.14: The empty Throne of Bhaal on a dark dais in the void, a thin bloodlight rising behind it, a low fire guttering at the foot of the steps.
